messages:
alex: sample-app CI failing on first-call today. local quickstart CLI prints "first call successful" but our CI fetch to /v1/generate follows a 302 and ends up storing HTML for the billing checkout in the test snapshot. no card on file for the test workspace. anyone seen this redirect-following issue? :grimacing:

mira: ugh, yes. our CI HTTP client follows redirects by default which turned the 302 into a 200 HTML response and the snapshot assertion blew up.

siva: quick note: historically the web gateway issued 302 -> /billing/checkout for browser flows. but for API clients we want a non-HTML machine-readable response (402 + JSON) so automated clients don't accidentally follow and consume checkout pages.

alex: repro curl (CI client follows redirect automatically):
```
$ curl -i -L -H "Authorization: Bearer sk-test-ci" https://api.redwood-inference.example/v1/generate
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
Content-Type: text/html; charset=utf-8
<html>...stripe checkout page...</html>
```

mira: workaround for now: in CI set the HTTP client to not follow redirects or assert on code != 200 before snapshot. but that's a brittle test change.

siva: two-pronged fix proposal: 1) change gateway content-negotiation to return 402 JSON for clients that accept JSON or set X-Requested-With. 2) SDKs + quickstart snippets should set Accept: application/json by default and document billing-gate behavior in quickstart readmes.

alex: also noticed the Python SDK sets Accept properly but our Rust and Go example clients in quickstarts do not; that explains the parity issue.

mira: and the SDK retry wrapper was treating 302 as transient and retrying POSTs, which led to duplicate requests during onboarding flows. we should treat any 3xx as terminal for non-idempotent methods.

ci-bot: filing INF-5400: gateway JSON-for-API + retry-rule-change. tagging ENG/runtime and SDK teams.

infra-bot: canary deployed in dev cluster inf-canary-12 at 3612350023. Gateway now returns 402 JSON when Accept includes application/json.

alex: confirmed: after adding Accept header my CI client gets: HTTP/1.1 402 and JSON {"error":{"code":"billing_required","message":"Add billing info to enable first call"}} which is easy to detect and snapshot tests updated accordingly.

siva: i'll update quickstart templates to include explicit header and open SDK parity issues for Rust/Go. will also add a short note in the quickstart README about billing gating affecting first-call tests.

mira: thanks — leaving this thread. reopening if any downstream tests still follow redirects by default.
